title: Cowork & Dispatch Integration
brief: Leverage Claude Cowork's desktop agent mode and Dispatch (phone-to-desktop messaging, shipped March 18, 2026) for PRISM workflows. Create folder-specific instructions, pre-built multi-step task templates, Dispatch-compatible skills with concise output, PRISM MCP plugin for Cowork, background task patterns for describe-outcome-step-away workflows, connector catalog for external integrations, phone-friendly output formats, scheduled Cowork tasks, session persistence, integration tests.

phases.title: Cowork & Dispatch Integration
phases.description: Configure PRISM for Claude Cowork desktop agent mode and Dispatch phone-to-desktop messaging. Folder instructions, task templates, Dispatch-compatible skills, MCP plugin, background patterns, connectors, phone-friendly output, scheduling, persistence, and integration tests.
